title: My diary
intro: Self-monitoring is the first step of change. Your entries are kept only on this phone, encrypted.

urge.title: Urge entry
urge.hint: In three taps: how strong, what happened, what you did.
urge.dayy: How were you at that moment? (optional)
urge.saved: Logged. Noticing is half of managing.

behavior.title: Behaviour entry
behavior.hint: No judgement. Noticing what happened is preparing for next time.

week.title: This week's summary
week.empty: The summary needs at least {min} entries this week. You have {n} entries now.
week.emotions: You usually felt “{before}” before and “{after}” afterwards.
week.note: This summary is for awareness; it's not an assessment or a grade.

list.title: Recent entries
list.empty: No entries yet. You can add an urge or behaviour entry.
